title: Mitigation of Blood Borne Cell Attachment to Metal Implants through CD47-Derived Peptide Immobilization
protocol: Wash stainless steel coupons or mesh disks twice in 2-isopropanol at 60°C and 200 rpm for 5 min each.
Wash the stainless-steel samples with chloroform twice at 60°C and 200 rpm for 10 min each.
Bake the cleansed stainless-steel samples at 220°C for 30 min in an oven.
Dissolve 25 mg of PABT and 5 mg of potassium bicarbonate in 5 mL of DDW to prepare a 0.5% PABT solution.
Incubate the PABT solution with potassium bicarbonate at 72°C for 30 min in a shaker at 200 rpm.
Immerse the baked foils or mesh disks in the 0.5% aqueous PABT solution and incubate at 72°C for 1 h in a shaker at 200 rpm.
Wash the PABT-modified samples five times with deionized distilled water (DDW).
Transfer the washed specimens to new vials and wash again with DDW five times.
Dissolve 60 mg of Tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride in 5 mL of 0.1 M acetic buffer to prepare a TCEP solution at 12 mg/mL concentration.
Treat PABT-modified samples with TCEP for 15 min at room temperature on a shaker.
Degas DDW in a round bottom flask using a vacuum generating device, such as a lyophilizer.
Wash TCEP-treated foils or mesh disks with degassed DDW five times.
Transfer the washed samples to a new vial.
Wash the transferred samples with degassed DDW an additional five times.
Wash the samples twice with degassed ethanol and twice with degassed dimethyl formamide (DMF).
Prepare 5 mL of 1% PEI-PDT solution by diluting 212.5 µL of stock PEI-PDT with 125 µL of 0.4 M sodium acetate in degassed DDW.
Incubate washed stainless-steel specimens with 1% PEI-PDT.
Replace air with argon gas and seal the vials airtight.
Mix on a shaker at room temperature for 1 hour.
Store treated samples at 4 °C up to one week if not proceeding immediately to peptide conjugation.
Dissolve TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 powder in degassed DMF to a final concentration of 1 mg/mL.
Aliquot the stock solution in 1 mL portions and store under argon atmosphere at -20°C.
Reduce precipitated TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 stock using TCEP beads at a ratio of 1:1 for 20 minutes at room temperature, after removing supernatant from spun TCEP beads.
Dilute the 1 mg/mL stock solution with degassed DMF to prepare solutions of 10 µg/mL, 30 µg/mL, 100 µg/mL, and 200 µg/mL.

Incubate PEI-PDT modified foil coupons with 10 µg/mL, 30 µg/mL, 100 µg/mL, or 200 µg/mL of TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 in triplicates for each condition on a shaker at room temperature under argon atmosphere for 1 hour.
Incubate PEI-PDT modified mesh disks and bare metal controls with 100 µg/mL of TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 in triplicates at room temperature under argon atmosphere on a shaker for 1 hour.
Wash the fluorophore conjugated pepCD47-coated surfaces with DMF three times.
Wash with DMF/DDW in a 1:1 ratio.
Wash with DDW three times.
Incubate each washed surface in 0.3% SDS in 20 mM Tris pH 7.4 for five minutes at 70 °C on a shaker, repeating the process three times.
Wash with DDW three more times and change vials.
Perform one final wash with DDW.
Place control and covalently conjugated mesh disks on a microscope glass.
Add 50 μL of PBS to each disk.
Cover with a coverslip.
Image mesh disks using an inverted fluorescence microscope equipped with a rhodamine filter set at 100x magnification.
Prepare 15 mL of 12 mg/mL TCEP solution by dissolving 180 mg of TCEP in a 1:1 v/v mixture of methanol and 0.1 M acetic buffer.
Incubate each washed foil with 1 mL of TCEP solution on a shaker at room temperature for 15 min.
Prepare TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 standards by serially diluting the stock (1 mg/mL) to concentrations of 100 µg/mL, 10 µg/mL, 1 µg/mL, 0.1 µg/mL, and 0.01 µg/mL.
Use TCEP solution as the diluent for preparing standards.
Analyze TAMRA-conjugated pepCD47 released from the metal surface against the calibration curve generated using the standards by fluorimetry at 544/590 nm excitation and emission wavelengths.
Wash PEI-PDT coated samples with degassed DDW five times, changing vials after each wash.
Perform an additional five washes with degassed DDW.
Prepare a human pepCD47 stock solution (1 mg/mL) by dissolving human pepCD47 powder in degassed 50% acetic acid.
Dissolve 500 µL of the stock human pepCD47 in 4,500 µL of degassed 1x phosphate buffered saline (PBS) to prepare a working concentration of 100 µg/mL.
Incubate washed PEI-PDT coated samples with 100 µg/mL of pepCD47 at room temperature with shaking for 1 hour.

Wash human pepCD47-coated samples in PBS three times, distilled deionized water (DDW) three times, 0.2% Tween-20 three times for five minutes each, and DDW three more times before changing vials and performing a final DDW wash.
Dissolve scrambled sequence powder in degassed 0.1% acetic acid to prepare a stock solution of 1 mg/mL.
Prepare a working solution of 100 µg/mL scrambled peptide by dissolving 500 µL of the stock in 4,500 µL of degassed 0.1% acetic acid.
Coat washed PEI-PDT specimens with 100 µg/mL of scrambled peptide at room temperature with shaking for 1 hour.
Wash surfaces with 0.01% acetic acid three times, DDW three times, 0.2% Tween-20 three times for five minutes each, and DDW three more times before changing vials and performing a final DDW wash.
Cut PVC tubes into three pieces of 38 cm length.
Insert up to eight unmodified, scrambled peptide, or pepCD47 modified metal foils in the PVC tubes.
Collect 30 mL of blood from healthy human donors free of any anti-platelet medications as per institutional IRB protocol.
Preload syringe with 1 mL of 4% sodium citrate to prevent coagulation of collected blood.
Put 10 mL of blood into each tube using a 10 mL syringe and connect the ends with metal adapters.
Place the blood-filled tubes on the wheels of the Chandler loop apparatus.
Pass the blood along the metal foils by wheel rotation at 37 °C at the speed calculated to produce the shear of 25 dyns/cm² for 4 h.
Drain the blood from the tubes and dispose of the blood according to the IRB requirements.
Cut the tubes using the scalpel to retrieve the foils from each tube.
Prepare 2% glutaraldehyde solution by diluting the 10 ml of 4% glutaraldehyde solution using 10 mL of sodium cacodylate buffer with 0.1 M sodium chloride.
Incubate the foils in 2% glutaraldehyde solution for 15 min and store at 4 °C overnight.
Before analyzing, wash the metal foils 3x with PBS.
Warm 8 mL of PBS in a 15 mL tube in a water bath set to 37 °C.
Prepare the CFDA dye stock concentration by adding 90 µL of DMSO to one CFDA dye vial.
Dilute 75 µL of the stock CFDA into 8 mL of warm PBS to achieve a working concentration of 93.75 µM.
Mix the solution by inverting the tubes a few times and cover the tube with aluminium foil.
Collect 10 mL of peripheral blood via the vena cava access during the sacrifice of a rat.
Mix collected blood immediately with sodium heparin to prevent coagulation.
Pipette 10 mL of density gradient medium into a 50 mL conical tube.
Mix blood with 5 mL of PBS and layer diluted blood over the density gradient medium.
Centrifuge at 800 x g for 20 min with minimal acceleration and deceleration settings.
Collect an opaque layer of buffy coat on the interface between plasma and Ficoll using a Pasteur pipette.
Dilute collected buffy coat 1:3 with PBS and centrifuge at 550 x g for 10 min to concentrate cells.
Resuspend buffy coat cells in ACK lysis buffer to lyse contaminating erythrocytes, incubate on ice for 4 min.
Add cell separation buffer (CSB) to the lysed cells and mix well.
Centrifuge at 550 x g for 10 min to pellet mononuclear cells.
Resuspend the pellet in CSB and centrifuge at 200 x g for 10 min to eliminate platelets.
Repeat the final centrifugation step twice.
Re-suspend the pellet in 500 µL of CSB.
Add 10 µg of each mouse anti-rat antibody: CD8a, anti-CD5, anti-CD45RA, and anti-CD6.
Incubate at 4 °C on a vertical tube rotator for 1 h.
Add 9.5 mL of CSB.
Centrifuge at 300 x g and 4 °C for 10 min.
Discard supernatant.
Re-suspend the pellet in 10 mL of CSB.
Repeat centrifugation.
Re-suspend the pellet in 500 µL of CSB.
Add 150 µL of goat anti-mouse IgG microbeads.
Incubate at 4 °C on a vertical tube rotator for 20 min.
Add 9.5 mL of CSB.
Centrifuge at 300 x g and 4 °C for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Re-suspend the pellet in 1 mL of CSB.
Place an LS column in a magnetic separator.
Prime the LS column with 3 mL of CSB.
Add 1 mL of re-suspended cell pellet.
Start collecting the throughput.
After flow stops, add 5 mL of CSB and keep collecting until the flow stops.
Centrifuge the column throughput at 300 x g and 4 °C for 10 min.
Re-suspend the resulting small pellet in 2 mL of RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% FCS, 1% pen/strep, and 100 ng/mL rat macrophage colony stimulating factor (M-CSF).
Count the monocytes using a hemocytometer.
Adjust monocyte concentration to 5 x 10^5 cells/mL.
Add 1 mL volumes of monocyte suspension to the individual wells of a 12 well plate with bare stainless steel foil samples or stainless steel samples modified with rat pepCD47.
Change the medium on days 3 and 5 post-seeding.
Wash cells with PBS and fix with 4% paraformaldehyde at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash twice with PBS for 5 min.
Remove the stainless-steel foils and place them individually into a new 12 well plate without flipping.
Incubate in 0.5% Tween-20/PBS for 15 min to permeabilize cells.
Wash twice with PBS for 5 min.
Block in 10% goat serum/PBS for 20 min.
Aspirate the serum and do not wash.
Add mouse anti-rat CD68 antibody (diluted 1:100 in 1% BSA/PBS).
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash 3 times with PBS for 5 min each.
Add goat anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 546 (diluted 1:200 in 1% BSA/PBS).
Incubate in dark at room temperature for 45 min.
Wash in PBS for 5 min.
Counterstain with 1 μg/mL Hoechst 33342 dye in dark at room temperature for 10 min.
Wash 3 times in PBS for 5 min each.
Image the foils using a fluorescent microscope with inverted optics at 200x magnification and blue/red filter settings.
Count the attached monocytes in individual images and calculate group averages and standard deviations.
